description:
High in the Andes, the air turns crisp as twilight settles across the stone terraces. In this quiet 15th-century Inca village, the work of the day slowly shifts toward the warmth of the ayllu firelight. We'll linger by hearths of clay and smoke, listening to the soft rustle of dried quinoa stored up in the rafters, and watch weaver's hands guide fleece across traditional looms. Together, we will wander past terrace sluices where mountain water trickles steadily through stone channels, explore alcoves filled with fragrant highland herbs, and pause at a star-watcher's stone bench to gaze into the clear night sky. As the village settles behind woven doorways and partitioned sleeping chambers, let the peaceful hum of high-altitude life drift you into a deep, restful sleep.

# Thumbnail master prompts

**Video:** Fall Asleep to Quiet Life in the Inca Empire (3 Hours)

## Concept 1: "HOW INCAS SLEPT"

**Image prompt (copy-paste):**
```
A painterly cinematic oil painting of a 15th-century Inca mountain home interior at night, 16:9 aspect ratio. On the right third, a warm stone hearth fire casts a golden amber glow onto hand-woven alpaca wool textiles, clay cooking pots, and wooden weaving tools resting against rustic dry-stone walls. The left 40% of the frame is cast in deep shadow and dark night-blue darkness, creating clean negative space for text. Deep indigo night sky visible through a small stone window opening. Cozy, warm ambient firelight, rich painterly textures, high contrast for small display. No people, no faces, no text in image.
```

**Text on thumbnail:** HOW INCAS SLEPT

**Design notes:** Bold rustic serif font in soft cream (#FFF8E7). Placed in the upper-left dark area. Add a dark subtle drop shadow to make the light lettering stand out against the shadowy mountain background.

## Concept 2: "INCA STAR GAZING"

**Image prompt (copy-paste):**
```
A painterly cinematic oil painting of 15th-century Inca stone terraces under a quiet starry night, 16:9 aspect ratio. On the right third, a small clay oil lamp sits on a rough stone wall, illuminating a bundle of dried quinoa, small clay jars, and a gently trickle of water in a stone channel. The left 40% of the composition is dominated by deep navy blue shadows and dark mountain mist, providing clear negative space. Rich starry indigo sky above the distant Andean silhouettes. High contrast, warm golden lantern glow, painterly oil brushwork. No faces, no text in image.
```

**Text on thumbnail:** INCA STAR GAZING

**Design notes:** Clean semi-bold sans-serif font in warm gold (#F4C430). Positioned mid-left. Use a slight outer glow in deep indigo to crisp up the edges against the dark backdrop.

## Concept 3: "WARM INCA NIGHTS"

**Image prompt (copy-paste):**
```
A painterly cinematic oil painting of a peaceful 15th-century Inca weaver's nook, 16:9 aspect ratio. On the right third, a wooden loom holding dyed alpaca yarn in earthy crimson and ochre is bathed in cozy amber light from a small ceramic lamp, beside hanging bundles of dried mountain herbs. The left 40% of the image is smooth, moody dark blue and midnight shadow, ideal for overlay text. High contrast lighting between warm hearth glow and cool midnight ambient tones, rich painterly stroke detail. No faces, no text in image.
```

**Text on thumbnail:** WARM INCA NIGHTS

**Design notes:** Elegant classic serif font in bright pale amber (#FFE5B4). Placed in the lower-left dark negative space. Pair with a very subtle dark vignette to enhance readability at small thumbnail sizes.
